title: feat: Add Support for Homey API Integration
body:
### Describe the feature you'd like to request

I would like to request integration support for Homey (https://homey.app/) within Homarr. Homey is a smart home hub developed by Athom that supports a wide range of devices and protocols (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, IR, etc.) and provides a powerful REST API.

The integration would allow Homarr users to:
- View a list of Homey-connected devices
- Display device names, capabilities (e.g., temperature, power usage), and statuses
- Possibly send actions or flows to Homey (e.g., toggle a device, start a scene)

### Additional information

Example API Interaction (using Homey's REST API):

```ts
const apiUrl = 'http://<homey-ip>/api/manager/devices/device/';
const bearerToken = '<user_token>';
fetch(apiUrl, {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${bearerToken}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }
})
  .then(response => response.json())
  .then(data => console.log(data));
```

This returns a JSON array of devices with their capabilities, status, and metadata, which can be easily displayed in a dashboard environment like Homarr.

Authentication:
The API uses a Bearer token format that includes both user and app tokens. Authentication is straightforward and can be securely stored in Homarr's settings.

More info here: https://support.homey.app/hc/en-us/articles/8178797067292-Getting-started-with-API-Keys

I also would submit a Pull Request to add this Homey widget once a Home Assistant version is available in Homarr, since I suck at designing.

full_comments.body: Hi, thanks for the request. We'd be happy to accept your contribution. Homeassistant is already available, so is there anything else you're waiting for?
Oh, i didnt knew that. Is there a PR-Request for that so I what do I have to change?

> I also would submit a Pull Request to add this Homey widget once a Home Assistant version is available in Homarr

You said that you would submit a pull request. You can submit it anytime, carefully read our contribution guidelines and mark as "ready for review" once you're done.
I ment a HA Pull Request, but I'll dig myself through the code to see how I can implement a new integration

Ok, no worries. As mentioned, we already implemented Homeassistant in #578, but honestly you're better off by copying an existing integration in the current code base, since it has changed since that PR.
Also note that the existing widgets and integration require the integration to be able to fetch using "entity IDs". If the Smart Home, you're looking to integrate, doesn't have a similar system, it will be more complex.

> it will be more complex

It definitely is. The Homarr codebase is quite complex, and I initially thought this would be an easy job, just adding an integration and changing the API and parser. But it looks like it’s more involved than that.

Would you be willing to develop this feature? I can provide remote access to my Homey using a reverse proxy and an API key.

Here is my current progress, though it’s not much yet: https://github.com/spkesDE/homarr/commit/b6435c4910392f50168ef4fca5a4b9c1a9a14771"
